hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash conn_user='postgres' conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-8086eb77-cd6d-48bc-9298-4380892798ca' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` database_psql_host_address='dictionarydb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com'
PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql \ --host="$database_psql_host_address" \ --port="5432" \ --username="$conn_user" \ --dbname="dictionary_db" \ -c "\q" # This command tests the connection and exits
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Connection test failed!" exit 1 fi
echo "Connection test successful!"
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` rm -f assume-role-output.txt
aws s3 cp ${dictionary_s3_uri} dictionary_db.tar mkdir temp_extract tar -xvf dictionary_db.tar -C temp_extract
mkdir dump_files find temp_extract -type f -exec mv {} dump_files/ \;
# Run pg_restore using the dump files provided in the dump_files workspace directory PGPASSWORD="${conn_pass}" \ /usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/pg_restore \ --host="${database_psql_host_address}" \ --port="5432" \ --username="${conn_user}" \ --dbname="dictionary_db" \ --format=d \ --jobs=10 \ --clean \ --verbose \ --no-owner \ --no-privileges \ --no-tablespaces \ --no-comments \ --no-publications \ --no-subscriptions \ --no-security-labels \ --no-table-access-method \ --schema="dict" \ "dump_files/"
